text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"“First, because… Second… Additionally… My first reason… My second reason… My last reason… In conclusion”","quality":"organizational structure","description":"This captures clearer paragraphing and signposted progression of ideas across the essay."},{"evidence":"“I would want to visit the zoo because…”, “This is the reason why I choose…”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"This captures fuller elaboration of points with repeated explanation and support rather than a brief list of preferences."},{"evidence":"“what happens when a animals get sick”, “what kind of medicine they give the animals”","quality":"content elaboration","description":"This captures more specific details and examples that expand on the main idea."},{"evidence":"“how is it like to work at the zoo is it hard or easy?”, “what happens when a animals get sick”","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"This captures more frequent use of subordinate clauses and extended sentence patterns."},{"evidence":"“I want to learn new things”, “I want to learn how you treat the animals”","quality":"academic tone","description":"This captures a more formal, school-like style with purpose statements instead of mostly conversational listing."}]}
